stable.releaseNotes: Promotes the locally validated single-store architecture: System Files runtime, protected Workspace data, authoritative-computer write control, revision-safe durable writes, origin-compatible launcher support, neutral Service Operations Dashboard naming, and complete restoration coverage for retained 0.10.9 Beta-touched files.

beta.releaseNotes: Adds visible installation progress with a live percentage, progress bar, current step, file-count detail, verified completion state, and rollback/recovery progress so System Updates no longer appears frozen during long file operations.
